items.headline: Former Mercedes engine boss returns to F1 with Audi

sources.evidence_excerpt: A former Mercedes-AMG High Performance Powertrains chief is returning to Formula 1, taking charge of Audi's power unit operation from November 1...
evidence_excerpts: A former Mercedes-AMG High Performance Powertrains chief is returning to Formula 1, taking charge of Audi's power unit operation from November 1...
The German manufacturer has appointed Andy Cowell’s Mercedes predecessor, Thomas Fuhr, to take over as CEO of its power unit department.
Fuhr will assume the role on November 1, 2026, strengthening the organisation’s leadership structure as Audi continues to develop its F1 power unit.
